Monday, oh Monday,
A day that starts the week,
A day that's full of dread,
And leaves us feeling weak.

No more sleeping in,
No more relaxing,
Just a jolt awake,
And a heavy heart sinking.

The alarm clock's harsh ring,
Buzzes in our ear,
Bringing us back to work,
And all our fear.

The commute is a drag,
The traffic's a mess,
And the thought of the day ahead,
Is enough to make us fuss.

Nine to five, the same routine,
Boring and uninspired,
Our creativity dries up,
And our motivation expired.

We trudge through the day,
Our minds on autopilot,
Until finally, the clock strikes five,
And we can go home and deflate.

Monday, oh Monday,
We dread you every week,
But until you're gone forever,
We'll just have to put up with.
